evidence_levels.sagejs_self_round_trip: Sage.js parses its own emitted finite-value and callback subset back to canonical intent and executes that intent through the shared Sage.js backend.
evidence_levels.vendored_grammar: The emitted body parses without an error node under Sage.js's vendored Tree-sitter grammar for the target language.
evidence_levels.official_reference_contract: Original Sage.js assertions about call syntax, shapes, callbacks, and target-native result conventions are linked to official vendor documentation.
evidence_levels.external_runtime_execution: The emitted program is executed in MATLAB, GNU Octave, or Wolfram Language and its target-native result is checked. This level has not been run.

matlab.reason: No MATLAB or GNU Octave executable was available on the persistent qualification hosts.

wolfram.reason: No Wolfram Language executable was available on the persistent qualification hosts.

programs.shape_convention: A two-element row literal is the documented bracketing input to fzero; the returned root is scalar.
programs.result_convention: result is MATLAB's scalar root estimate, not a Sage.js NumericalResult or evidence envelope.

programs.shape_convention: The three-element variable specification carries a variable and two starting values.
programs.result_convention: FindRoot returns replacement rules; result is not the scalar Sage.js root or its evidence envelope.

programs.shape_convention: A flat canonical right-hand side is converted from a row literal to a column with the nonconjugating transpose .'.
programs.result_convention: result is MATLAB's solution column; residual/evidence records are not transported.

programs.shape_convention: Nested lists are matrices and flat lists are vectors.
programs.result_convention: result is the solution vector returned by LinearSolve; Sage.js evidence is not transported.

programs.shape_convention: The flat right-hand side is explicitly made a column with the nonconjugating transpose .'.
programs.result_convention: result is MATLAB's minimum-norm least-squares solution column; diagnostics are not transported.

programs.shape_convention: Nested lists are matrices and flat lists are vectors.
programs.result_convention: result is the parameter vector returned by LeastSquares; validation evidence is not transported.

programs.shape_convention: The sample vector remains a row and fft preserves vector orientation.
programs.result_convention: result is MATLAB's unnormalized forward transform in the input orientation.

programs.shape_convention: A flat list is transformed to a flat list.
programs.result_convention: FourierParameters -> {0, -1} selects the unscaled negative-sign forward convention used by Sage.js.

programs.shape_convention: Both canonical flat vectors remain rows; full convolution therefore has row orientation.
programs.result_convention: result is MATLAB's full linear convolution vector.

programs.shape_convention: integral may supply array inputs, so multiplication, division, and powers in the scalar expression are emitted elementwise.
programs.result_convention: result is MATLAB's scalar quadrature estimate; error estimates and Sage.js evidence are not transported.

programs.shape_convention: The integration variable is applied explicitly to a pure Function and the bounds are scalar.
programs.result_convention: result is NIntegrate's approximate scalar; Sage.js error/evidence records are not transported.

programs.shape_convention: The callback and bounds are scalar.
programs.result_convention: result is the scalar minimizer returned by fminbnd, without the objective value or diagnostics.

programs.shape_convention: The scalar decision variable and scalar interval constraints are explicit.
programs.result_convention: The replacement rule from NMinimize is projected to a scalar minimizer with ReplaceAll and Last.

programs.shape_convention: The canonical initial vector is a row; p(1) and p(2) bridge MATLAB's one-based indexing to named scalar callback parameters.
programs.result_convention: result has the orientation of x0 and contains only fminsearch's minimizer in this single-output form.

programs.shape_convention: The callback emits a column residual with semicolon-separated entries and indexes the row initial vector from one.
programs.result_convention: result is fsolve's solution with the orientation of x0; exit flags and diagnostics are not transported.

programs.shape_convention: The residual callback emits a column and uses one-based indexing into the row initial vector.
programs.result_convention: result is lsqnonlin's solution in x0 orientation; residual and optimality diagnostics are not transported.

programs.shape_convention: xdata and ydata remain paired row vectors of equal length.
programs.result_convention: For degree one, polyfit returns [slope, intercept], matching the canonical primary coefficient order; inference evidence is not transported.

programs.shape_convention: The derivative callback emits a column and maps y(1), y(2) to named state parameters; t_span and y0 remain input rows.
programs.result_convention: Single-output ode45 returns a MATLAB solution structure, not the Sage.js trajectory/events/evidence result.
required_source_fragments: callback = @(t, y) feval(@(t, y0, y1) [y1; -y0], t, y(1), y(2));

programs.shape_convention: The canonical flat sample is normalized to a column for reductions. Quartiles and median absolute deviation explicitly use zero-based (n-1)p positions translated to MATLAB's one-based indexing.
programs.result_convention: result is a MATLAB struct carrying every canonical default descriptive-statistics field, ddof=1, and the explicit linear-r-type-7 quantile label; target-native floating reduction order may differ in the last bits from Sage.js.
